messages:
ashley: Kicking off the regional GPU burncycle plan for ap-east-1 tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Need quick read + handoff. Plan: warmup -> sustained soak -> peak ramp -> verification.

mike: Nice. Can you post the minimal checklist? I'll run the load harness.

ashley: Minimal checklist:
- infra: ensure all GPU pools in Ready state
- networking: egress rules + NAT throughput check
- k8s: node allocatable and taints as expected
- monitoring: traces, per-pool latency, OOM/kubelet alerts wired to #eng-sre
- cost: estimate burn cost for 6h at peak

devon: Add GPU health: `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=temperature.gpu,utilization.gpu --format=csv` run before/after warmup.

linh: Autoscaler tune suggestion: default scale window is too aggressive for cold starts. Proposal: `scale_up_delay: 35s`, `scale_down_delay: 5m`, `target_util_pct: 55` for initial ramp.

jane: +1 on longer scale_down_delay. Also make sure instance quotas are reserved (contact cloud-quotas). I filed ticket #CLOUD-214.

mike: Load harness command I'm planning to use:
```
k6 run --vus 300 --duration 3h --out influxdb=ap-east1:8086 job-soak.js
# script will cycle prefix cache keys and vary seq len
```
I'll start with 60% target throughput for 3h then ramp to peak at 110% for 30m.

ashley: Cost estimate: rough numbers below:
- baseline soak (3h @60%): ~120 GPU-hours -> ~$2.4k
- peak ramp (0.5h @110%): ~25 GPU-hours -> ~$0.5k
Total ~ $3k incl network. Ops please confirm budget signoff.

soak-bot: Reminder scheduled: Regional GPU burncycle for ap-east-1 in 20 hours (command: `/soak schedule ap-east-1 2025-03-15T03:00Z`).

devon: Quick validation checks to run during warmup (0-30m):
1) `kubectl get nodes -l pool=gpu -o wide` -> all Ready and no DiskPressure
2) `kubectl top nodes` -> steady CPU/GPU usage low before load
3) `curl -sS http://prometheus.internal/api/v1/query?query=avg_over_time(node_gpu_temp[5m])`
If any node shows >85C or accelerated ECC errors, abort.

linh: On networking: watch TLS handshake rates per AZ, NAT gateway concurrency. We hit NAT EOF in eu-west on last launch. If we see `connection reset` spikes, fallback to regional gateway.

mike: During soak I'll stream a short dashboard to #eng-infra and give 15m updates. If autoscaler fails to add nodes within 90s, we fall back to provisioning extra reserved pools (preapproved).

jane: Handoff procedure for ops on-call:
- Verbally confirm budget & approval in thread
- Confirm cloud-quotas ticket cleared (CLOUD-214)
- Run warmup script and post screenshots of node lists
- If any alert fires, tag on-call and pause harness
- Post-run: collect `kubectl describe pod` for top 3 failing pods, `nvidia-smi` dump, and upload to S3 `s3://redwood-burncycle/ap-east-1/<ts>/`

ashley: I'm going to freeze autoscaler config for the run: attach below (do not change during test):
```
autoscaler:
  target_util_pct: 55
  max_replicas: 220
  scale_up_delay: 35s
  scale_down_delay: 5m
  max_node_add_rate: 12
```
Please don't tweak unless emergency.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered by ashley: `infrastructure/autoscaler/config@release-2025-03-14` -> staging validated.

mike: One more: throttling tolerance. We'll run a microtest for 15m at high concurrency first to make sure K8s and ingress don't rate-limit. If we see 429s > 0.5% we abort and investigate.

linh: Also watch KV cache hit rates. A cold-cache ramp can blow tokens. If cache hit < 30% after 20m, reduce sustained throughput to 40% and re-evaluate.

ashley: Budget signoff received from finance via DM. I'm handing off to mike & devon to execute run. I'll be on standby for 4h after start.

mike: Roger. Will post start + periodic updates here. Starting dry-run tonight at 23:00 UTC.

devon: Copy. I'll run the health script on rotation and upload artifacts.

ashley: Thanks team — keep comms short and actionable. Tag me if anything unexpected. :thumbsup:
